req.title: Return DELETE request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to DELETE /delete with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that DELETE /delete returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — plain DELETE with no body returns all required keys with correct types and status 200; (2) positive EP — DELETE with JSON body reflects json field correctly; (3) positive EP — DELETE with query string reflects args field; (4) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (GET) on /delete returns 405; (5) boundary BVA — DELETE with empty body yields data as empty string and json as null; (6) DT — DELETE with form data reflects form field; (7) BVA — exact key-set assertion catches any key added or removed by mutation.

tests.name: test_delete_plain_returns_200_and_all_required_keys
expected: JSON body contains exactly keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_plain_returns_200_and_all_required_keys():
    r = client.delete('/delete')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    required_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert set(body.keys()) == required_keys
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert 'delete' in body['url']
    assert isinstance(body['args'], dict)
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    assert isinstance(body['form'], dict)
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert isinstance(body['files'], dict)

test_delete_plain_returns_200_and_all_required_keys()

tests.name: test_delete_with_query_string_reflects_args
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_with_query_string_reflects_args():
    r = client.delete('/delete?foo=bar&baz=qux')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar', 'baz': 'qux'}
    assert body['args'].get('foo') == 'bar'
    assert body['args'].get('baz') == 'qux'
    assert len(body['args']) == 2

test_delete_with_query_string_reflects_args()

tests.name: test_delete_with_form_data_reflects_form_field
actions: Send DELETE /delete with application/x-www-form-urlencoded body field=hello
trace: R-HTTPBIN-010 — DT: form data path; get_dict sets form=semiflatten(request.form)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_with_form_data_reflects_form_field():
    r = client.delete(
        '/delete',
        data={'field': 'hello'},
        content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert body['form'] == {'field': 'hello'}
    assert body['form'].get('field') == 'hello'
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == ''

test_delete_with_form_data_reflects_form_field()

tests.name: test_delete_response_exact_key_set_no_extra_no_missing
actions: Send DELETE /delete and inspect response key set exactly
expected: JSON body has exactly 8 keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin — no more, no fewer
trace: R-HTTPBIN-010 — BVA: exact key-set boundary; catches mutations that add/remove keys from get_dict call
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_response_exact_key_set_no_extra_no_missing():
    r = client.delete('/delete')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    keys = set(body.keys())
    expected_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert keys == expected_keys
    assert len(keys) == 8
    assert 'method' not in keys
    assert 'url' in keys
    assert 'origin' in keys
    assert 'json' in keys

test_delete_response_exact_key_set_no_extra_no_missing()

tests.name: test_delete_headers_field_reflects_sent_header
actions: Send DELETE /delete with custom header X-Test-Header: sentinel-value
expected: headers field in response contains X-Test-Header with value sentinel-value
trace: R-HTTPBIN-010 — get_dict includes 'headers' from get_headers(); EP: custom header reflected
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_headers_field_reflects_sent_header():
    r = client.delete(
        '/delete',
        headers={'X-Test-Header': 'sentinel-value'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert 'headers' in body
    hdrs = body['headers']
    assert isinstance(hdrs, dict)
    found = {k.lower(): v for k, v in hdrs.items()}
    assert found.get('x-test-header') == 'sentinel-value'

test_delete_headers_field_reflects_sent_header()
